description: A React component for a learner's settings page, including profile, security, notifications, learning preferences, accessibility, privacy, linked accounts, system preferences, support, and account actions.

methods.name: handleProfileSave
methods.description: Handles saving the profile data by calling updateProfile and updating current user state.

methods.name: ProfileSettings
methods.description: Component for editing user profile information, including full name, professional title, and timezone.

methods.name: AccountSecurity
methods.description: Component for managing account security, including password change and active sessions.

methods.name: NotificationPreferences
methods.description: Component for setting notification preferences and reminder frequency.

methods.name: LearningPreferences
methods.description: Component for setting learning target, language, content preferences, and playback speed.

methods.name: AccessibilitySettings
methods.description: Component for adjusting accessibility options like font size, high contrast, and captions.

methods.name: PrivacyData
methods.description: Component for privacy and data sharing settings.

methods.name: LinkedAccounts
methods.description: Component for managing linked sign-in accounts.

methods.name: SystemPreferences
methods.description: Component for system appearance and display settings.

methods.name: SupportHelp
methods.description: Component providing links to support resources.

methods.name: AccountActions
methods.description: Component for account deactivation and organization info.

methods.name: ReadOnlyField
methods.description: Reusable component to display read-only profile data.

methods.name: ToggleRow
methods.description: Reusable toggle switch component with label and description.

methods.name: SaveButton
methods.description: Reusable button component for saving changes.
